;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)]]
**An [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] suicide bomber kills 14 people and wounds over 60 others at a police checkpoint near [[Hamid Karzai International Airport]]. The attack coincides with Afghan Vice President [[Abdul Rashid Dostum]] returning to [[Afghanistan]] after more than a year in exile in [[Turkey]]. Dostum and his entourage are unhurt. [https://www.wsj.com/articles/suicide-bomber-attacks-kabul-airport-on-return-of-exiled-vice-president-1532280278 (''The Wall Street Journal'')]
*[[Yemeni Civil War (2015–present)]]
**A suspected U.S. drone strike kills four alleged [[al-Qaeda]] militants in [[Ma'rib]]. [https://www.apnews.com/f784a6cd9b4241ff9121f0873eeb6ddd/Suspected-US-airstrike-kills-4-al-Qaida-operatives-in-Yemen (AP)]
*[[2018 Toronto shooting]]
**A mass shooting in [[Toronto]], [[Ontario]], [[Canada]], occurs, leaving two people dead and 13 others injured. The shooter is found dead nearby after exchanging gunfire with police and fleeing. [https://www.apnews.com/23c21f7645c8406cb0e8587a405a9b12/The-Latest:-1-victim-dead-after-man-shoots-14-in-Toronto (AP)]

;Law and crime
*[[Protests against Emmanuel Macron]], [[Benalla affair]]
**A [[France|French]] judge hands preliminary charges to one of [[President of France|French President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s top security aides after video surfaced showing him attacking a protester at a [[May Day]] demonstration. [https://canoe.com/news/world/france-opens-judicial-probe-into-beating-by-president-emmanuel-macron-aide/amp (Canoe.com)]

;Sports
*[[2018 Open Championship]]
**[[Francesco Molinari]] wins the [[The Open Championship|British Open]] at [[Carnoustie Golf Links|Carnoustie]] for his first [[Men's major golf championships|major title]] by two strokes over a group including past major winners [[Rory McIlroy]] and [[Justin Rose]]. [[Tiger Woods]], Molinari's playing partner for the final round, finishes one shot further back in a tie for sixth. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/2018-british-open-francesco-molinari-wins-open-championship-as-tiger-woods-falls-short/ (CBS News)]
*[[2018 Rugby World Cup Sevens – Men's tournament]]
**[[New Zealand national rugby sevens team|New Zealand]] defeats [[England national rugby sevens team|England]] 33–12 in the final to win the 2018 men's [[Rugby World Cup Sevens]]. [https://www.radionz.co.nz/news/sport/362393/rugby-sevens-nz-men-win-world-cup (Radio New Zealand)]
*[[Football in Germany]]
**[[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] and [[Germany national football team|German]] professional footballer [[Mesut Özil]] announces his retirement from international football, citing racism and disrespect. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/2018/jul/22/mesut-ozil-retires-german-national-team-discrimination (''The Guardian'')]
